description: Get the earnings-call event for a company's fiscal quarter: one record grouping the call's audio, transcript, slide deck and 8-K earnings release. Returns the event id, title, call date, status, each artefact's status (available, pending, notPublished, failed, notAttempted, noCallHeld) with its reason and capture times, the transcript and release document ids, and approved guidance rows from the 8-K. Omit the fiscal period for the latest call; read the transcript with GetEarningsCallTranscript.

fiscalQuarter.description: Company fiscal quarter, 1-4. Quarter alone selects the latest matching quarter across fiscal years; provide both fields for an exact period.

fiscalYear.description: Company fiscal year. Omit both period fields for the latest call; year alone selects the latest call in that fiscal year.

ticker.description: Company ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT), or MIC:TICKER (e.g., XPAR:AIR) for a listing outside the US.

name: GetEarningsCallEvent
title: Earnings Call Event
